name: Arcadeous
subtitle: Own an arcade. Play every machine.
localizedDescription:
Own an arcade from minute one. Fill the floor with cabinets you can walk up to and actually play, set the ticket payout, stock the prize counter and keep the crowd coming back. A first-person arcade management sim where every machine is a real game.

• 59 playable cabinets: 50 coin-op games plus 9 ticket games, original games in the classic 1980s arcade style, drawn in real pixel art, including the fighter DOJO
• Ticket games, a prize counter and a prize wall of upgrades
• Where a machine sits changes what it earns: sightlines, walking routes and neighbours
• One new idea at a time: quarter games, then ticket games, then the ticket booth, then your own prize wall

iPhone beta: an on-screen controller (left thumb moves, drag right to look, tap to use; A B X Y in every cabinet).

versions.localizedDescription:
- Swapping buttons tells you what moved. Swapping two buttons in Settings › Controller moves BOTH jobs, so swapping A with B puts Back (and Pause) on A. The page now says exactly which button does what after a swap; Reset to default puts everything back. (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
- A remapped controller names the right buttons. After you swapped buttons in Settings › Controller, a game's hints could still name the old button (and on a Nintendo-style pad, A and B could come out swapped). Every prompt now names the button you chose. (Thanks to the tester who sent this with /bug.)
- Every on-screen button works where it's drawn. Since full screen, a tap on ☰ (or BUILD, or any on-screen button) on a wide phone landed to the left of where you touched, so you had to tap to the right of the icon. Every tap lands exactly where you touch now.
- The opening cards are centred. The studio logo and the title card sat off to one side on a wide phone or an iPad, with the title and its tagline out of line. Both are centred and fill the screen now.
- Cloud saves show your money right. The cloud panel showed $72125 where it meant $721.25.
